title: Format: `- [ ] [ID] [P?] [Story?] Description`
description: - **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies)

title: Phase 1: Setup (Shared Infrastructure)
description: **Purpose**: Project initialization, environment configuration, and basic structure setup.

title: Phase 2: Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)
description: **Purpose**: Core infrastructure required by ALL user stories - database schema, authentication framework, and base services.

title: Phase 3: User Story 1 - Discord Member Authentication (Priority: P1) 🎯 MVP
description: **Goal**: Authenticate users via Discord OAuth with server membership verification (Guild 1254761492608188517), re-check membership every 10 logins, handle non-members gracefully.

title: Phase 4: User Story 2 - Create and Save Evaluations (Priority: P1) 🎯 MVP
description: **Goal**: Authenticated users can create evaluations, answer 20 questions, add notes, auto-save to database, access from any device, export as Markdown.

title: Phase 5: User Story 3 - Dual-Tone Content Toggle (Priority: P2)
description: **Goal**: Users can toggle between "No BS" and "Corporate Friendly" modes, all content (questions, categories, pages) changes instantly (<500ms), preference saved in localStorage.

title: Phase 6: User Story 4 - Admin Content Management (Priority: P2)
description: **Goal**: Admins can access /admin panel, CRUD questions/categories/vendors/pages, auto-generate corporate versions with Claude API, manage users and feedback.

title: Create README.md with setup instructions per quickstart.md
Phase 7: User Story 5 - Invite Code System (Priority: P3)
description: **Goal**: Admins can create invite codes (7-day default expiration), non-Discord users can use codes to request magic link, gain access after clicking link.

title: Phase 8: User Story 6 - Feedback System (Priority: P3)
description: **Goal**: Users see feedback widget on every page, can submit feedback, feedback stored in database AND creates GitHub issue with "user-feedback" label, admin can review in panel.

title: Phase 9: User Story 7 - View Official Vendor Analyses (Priority: P3)
description: **Goal**: Users can view pre-analyzed vendors (e.g., Glean) with official answers to all 20 questions, evidence for each answer, dual-tone support for questions and evidence.

title: Phase 10: Data Migration & Content Generation
description: **Purpose**: Migrate existing Phase I content (categories, questions, Glean data) to database, auto-generate corporate versions using Claude API.

title: Phase 11: Testing After Feature Areas
description: **Purpose**: Comprehensive integration and E2E testing after all feature areas complete per spec requirement (test after each feature area).

title: Phase 12: Deployment & Production Setup
description: **Purpose**: Deploy frontend to Vercel, backend to Supabase production, configure external services.

title: Phase 13: Polish & Cross-Cutting Concerns
description: **Purpose**: Final improvements, documentation updates, performance optimization.

title: Type mismatch: shared/types uses camelCase but database uses snake_case
description:
The shared/types/index.ts file defines types with camelCase fields (vendorName, questionId, createdAt, etc.) but the database schema uses snake_case (vendor_name, question_id, created_at, etc.). This causes TypeScript build errors across all components that use database data.

Options to fix:
1. Update shared/types to match database schema (use snake_case throughout)
2. Create database-to-frontend type mappers
3. Update database schema to use camelCase (not recommended for PostgreSQL)

Recommendation: Update shared/types to match database snake_case convention, as this is the PostgreSQL standard and we're building a database-first application.

title: Deprecate Phase I LocalStorage data files (src/data/*)
description:
Phase I used LocalStorage with static data files in src/data/questions.ts, src/data/categories.ts, src/data/vendors.ts. Phase II moved to database-first architecture. These files are now obsolete and causing TypeScript errors.

Files to remove or refactor:
- apps/evaluation-tool/src/data/questions.ts (static Question array)
- apps/evaluation-tool/src/data/categories.ts (static Category array)  
- apps/evaluation-tool/src/data/vendors.ts (static pre-analyzed vendors)
- Related hooks/components that import from these files

All components should use databaseService queries instead of static imports.

1. Removed unused useAuth import from AuthCallback.tsx

2. Changed 'any[]' to 'Answer[]' in database.ts updateEvaluation function
3. Added eslint-disable comments for react-refresh/only-export-components in AuthContext.tsx, ToneContext.tsx, useVoiceMode.tsx (intentional pattern for context providers)
4. Added eslint-disable-next-line for react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in EvaluationList.tsx, AuthCallback.tsx, Evaluate.tsx (dependencies managed intentionally)

Build now passes cleanly with no errors, linting passes with no warnings.

- SEE category, F grade: 'F: You cannot see enough to know if this tool is truly useful.'
- CHANGE category, D grade: 'D: Significant lock-in risks detected.'
- USE category, B grade: 'B: Strong usability with minor concerns.'

Remove all progress bars and completion percentages from the summary section.
